name: NASA SMAP / MSL
what_it_is: Spacecraft telemetry, 82 channels, 105 labelled anomaly sequences of point and contextual type.
why_not_used: Anonymised time axis and pre-scaled values. No 168 h terminal target and no component identity, so neither module can be scored on it.
licence: Apache-2.0 (code); NASA telemetry released for research use

confirms_exclusion.note: Rows are per-channel telemetry segments. There is no part, lot or wafer identity and no terminal parametric value, so neither the Module A lot-relative statistics nor the Module B 0 h + 24 h -> 168 h target can be constructed from it.

name: NASA IMS bearing
what_it_is: Run-to-failure bearing vibration, roughly 164 h of 10-minute files.
why_not_used: Vibration, not parametric electrical data. The degradation shape is instructive but the features do not transfer.

metadata.error: no machine-readable index published; landing page only

bulk.reason: requires interactive download from the landing page

name: CWRU bearing
what_it_is: Seeded bearing faults at steady state across several loads.
why_not_used: Classification data, not run-to-failure. Provides no drift trajectory and no remaining-life signal.
licence: Case Western Reserve University, free for research use
